releaseNotes.zh: 助手新增拍照识别与语音转文字，支持健身模式营养估算。入库前确认，操作可撤销。需要邀请码；请覆盖安装以保留本地数据。
releaseNotes.en: Agent photo input and editable voice dictation, plus Fitness mode nutrition estimates. Review before adding stock and undo supported changes. Invite required; install over the existing app to keep local data.
